final: WITH r AS (SELECT positionText AS code, CASE WHEN laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS INTEGER) END AS lp FROM results), g AS (SELECT code, SUM(lp) AS ls FROM r GROUP BY code), t AS (SELECT SUM(ls) AS total FROM g), j AS (SELECT g.code, g.ls, CAST(g.ls AS REAL) / t.total AS div FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(div) AS avgdiv FROM j), k AS (SELECT j.code, j.ls, j.div, j.div - a.avgdiv AS diff FROM j JOIN a ON a.avgdiv IS NOT NULL WHERE j.div > a.avgdiv) SELECT SUM(ls), AVG(div), AVG(diff) FROM k
